HTS FI Ex360_ Em465: Raw fluorescent intensity value at excitation 360 nm and emission 465 nm measured on the M5 microtiter plate reader
Z-score: Z-score computed on a plate by plate basis, where the Z-zcore for the raw value of Xi is: Zi=(Xi-Xm)/Sm
Plate Mean FI: Mean of the raw fluorescent intensity values of all the compounds on a plate (n=320)at excitation 360 nm and emission 465 nm measured on the M5 microtiter plate reader
Plate STD Dev FI: Standard deviation from the Mean of the raw fluorescent intensity values of all the compounds on a plate (n=320)at excitation 360 nm and emission 465 nm measured on the M5 microtiter plate reader
HTS Assay Date: Date the HTS assay was run
